summary.text: Anasina Gray-Barberio is a Greens member of the Legislative Council for Northern Metropolitan Region. She was appointed in November 2024 to the vacancy left by former Greens leader Samantha Ratnam, becoming the Victorian Parliament's first Samoan MP. Before that she worked in the community sector on health equity for Pacific Islander communities. She is recontesting Northern Metropolitan in 2026.

summary.text: Sheena Watt has been a Labor member of the Legislative Council for Northern Metropolitan Region since October 2020, when she succeeded Jenny Mikakos, and heads Labor's group (K) for the region at the 2026 election. A Yorta Yorta woman, she was the first Aboriginal woman to sit for Labor in the Victorian Parliament. Before entering Parliament she was an executive with AFL SportsReady, a youth employment organisation, and sat on health and community boards; since April 2026 her parliamentary secretary roles have covered public and active transport and community sport.
